sqlquery.from:
( select l.id, primaryEmail, sts.name statusNames, coalesce(ass.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(ass.lastname,'') assigneeName,jobTitles ,add.address street,add.city,add.zipCode,l.primaryPhone ,case ip.id when mb.id then ip.value end mobile ,case ip.id when wb.id then ip.value end website ,nt.leadNote ,coalesce(l.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(l.lastname,'') leadName ,ca.name crmAccount from "25782".crmcontact l left join "25782".reference sts on l.status=l.id left join "25782".myuser ass on l.assignee=ass.id left join "25782".crmaccount ca on l.crmAccount=ca.id left join (select add.contactID, min(id) id from "25782".address add where add.deleted is not true and add.entitytype='contact' and add.relationType in (1,2,7) group by add.contactID) x on l.id=x.contactid left join "25782".address add on x.id=add.id left join (select min(id) id, contactid from "25782".crmcontactitemparams where paramid=1 and relationid=3 group by contactid) mb on l.id=mb.contactid left join (select min(id) id, contactid from "25782".crmcontactitemparams where paramid=4 group by contactid) wb on l.id=wb.contactid left join "25782".crmcontactitemparams ip on ip.id in (mb.id,wb.id) left join ( select related_id,array_to_string(array_agg(distinct nt.comment|| (case when ''!=coalesce(trim(nt.comment),'') then ' {'||coalesce(u.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(u.lastname,'')||'}' else '' end ) ),'
') leadNote from "25782".note nt left join "25782".myuser u on nt.commentatorId=u.id where nt.related_to=16 group by related_id) nt on l.id=nt.related_id where l.deleted is not true and l.contacttype=5 ) t
